headline: Woman's body washes ashore in Newport Beach; police investigate

paragraphs.text: Police are investigating after a woman’s body washed ashore in Newport Beach on Thursday.

Details were scarce late Thursday on the case. The “identity and circumstances of the dead body are currently under investigation,” Newport Beach Police Department Lt. Court Depweg said in a statement.
Lifeguards called police to report the body on the beach near 34th Street around 12:45 p.m., police said.
The body appeared to be that of an adult female who “was washed up out of the ocean,” police said. Newport Beach police and the Orange County Coroner Division are investigating.
The department provided no further information about the case.

Although the circumstances around the death are unclear, Newport Beach is one of a number of coastal Southern California communities that have been battling king tides and high surf that have caused hazardous beach conditions. Officials have warned of huge waves, rip currents and sneaker waves even as conditions have sent water crashing over seawalls and into people’s homes.
